title: Emergency Condition Classes for Dispatch Charges, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, the emergency dispatch charge carries a condition-class multiplier, applied to the program's emergency dispatch fee in the scheduled dispatch charge.

**Rule.** The condition-class multiplier follows the emergency condition reported on the dispatched item: a gas leak or a total electrical loss, which are safety calls, takes 0.50; no heat or no cooling, which are comfort calls, takes 0.80; any other emergency condition takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Emergency condition reported on the dispatched item | Class | Condition-class multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| gas leak | safety call | 0.50 |
| total electrical loss | safety call | 0.50 |
| no heat | comfort call | 0.80 |
| no cooling | comfort call | 0.80 |
| any other emergency condition | — | 1.00 |

**Points of reading.** The condition is the one reported when the dispatched item was filed, not the condition the technician later found. Hypothetical illustration: a dispatch to an item reported as no heat takes 0.80 even where the technician could not reproduce the condition.
